statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Mandatory French language with Latin script; no transliteration required
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Words reserved for regulated professions (e.g., banque, assurance); prior ministerial approval required for certain descriptive terms

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for administrative purposes provided a real registered office address is maintained for tax residency, legal service of process, and compliance with substance requirements
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium risk of unannounced physical inspections by tax authorities or commercial court for entities with foreign ownership

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code), articles L. 210-1 et seq. and subsequent provisions governing SARL
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte constitutif et statuts de la société (Articles of Association)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed and paid-up capital of 1 EUR; no escrow account required but capital must be paid in full before operations commence
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
Pro Forma First Board Resolution

The undersigned directors of RoyaltyFreeMusic SARL, a French Société à Responsabilité Limitée, resolve as follows:

1. To approve the subscription of the initial share capital by the shareholders as per the articles of association, with full payment of the subscribed capital.

2. To adopt the registered office at the company's principal address in France.

3. To appoint [Gérant Name] as Managing Director (Gérant) and [Director Name] as Director, conferring upon them all necessary powers for representation and daily management.

4. To authorize the filing of the incorporation documents with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce to obtain the SIREN number and to open a corporate bank account.

5. To approve the commencement of operations in commercial soundscape licensing and audio sample subscriptions.

This resolution is adopted unanimously on [Date] at [Location].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Signing, and Filing of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet-Entreprises portal or direct submission to Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: 1. Prepare detailed articles of association specifying share capital, object of the company (royalty-free stock music licensing), duration, registered office, and directors. 2. Have all shareholders sign the articles. 3. Notarize the documents if the greffe requires it. 4. Submit the package online or in person with the filing fee and supporting documents. 5. Await confirmation of SIREN/SIRET issuance.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
Proof of address for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried or incomplete, the applicant has 15 days to provide additional information or make corrections to proceed with approval.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No dedicated industrial licensing authority; digital services fall under general commercial regulations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required for royalty-free stock music licensing and audio subscriptions

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A - Digital operations involve no physical manufacturing, wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or waste handling; compliance with general environmental standards for office activities if applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for non-industrial digital business; standard occupational health and safety measures recommended for any office setup.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL entities obtain SIREN/SIRET from INSEE; register for corporate tax, social security contributions and VAT with DGFiP to acquire statutory TIN and VAT ID; foreign entities register via guichet unique digital portal or DGFiP for equivalent identification
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; default entity-level taxation applies under Code général des impôts; limited hybrid mismatch rules

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory facturation électronique with digital stamps; real-time fiscal clearance via Portail de l'Économie (PEP); API integration required

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT on exports of goods outside the EU and qualifying services supplied to non-EU customers with no French establishment
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fines up to 80% of tax evaded, interest charges and potential criminal sanctions for fraudulent zero-rating claims

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a fully convertible Euro regime. Capital and current account transactions face no restrictions on repatriation or profit remittances. All FX transactions subject to standard tax declarations and beneficial ownership reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export receipts. Proceeds may be retained in foreign currency accounts. All exports require customs and tax declarations; voluntary surrender available through authorized banks.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High viability for fintech EMIs including Stripe and PayPal. Legal constraints require PSD2 compliance, GDPR adherence, and French AML/CFT integration. Offshore digital EMIs feasible with proper entity structuring.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence required for directors and signatories in initial KYC and account opening. Remote digital onboarding permitted for subsequent transactions or existing clients.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial ownership or source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kbis extract, Articles of Association, beneficial ownership declaration, passport copies, and proof of funds origin

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained capital injections or high-volume transactions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder agreements, audited financials, tax residency certificates, and legal opinions

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital via SWIFT MT103 with purpose codes 'CAP' or 'EQTY'. Verification requires shareholder resolutions, bank statements, and French tax forms. All subject to €10,000 AML reporting threshold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements cleared via SWIFT MT103 and Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600). Trade settlements use French banks as clearing hubs for royalty and licensing payments.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS) rate applicable since 1 January 2022; reduced 15% rate applies to the first EUR 42,500 of annual taxable profit for qualifying SARLs with annual turnover not exceeding EUR 10,000,000 and fully paid-up share capital.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced small-business rate on first EUR 42,500 of profit; Crédit d'Impôt Recherche (CIR) for qualifying R&D in audio technology; Crédit d'Impôt Phonographique (CGI Art. 220 undecies) for eligible phonographic production expenditure; participation-exemption regime for inter-company dividends; no territorial scope relief for a French-resident SARL.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no statutory year cap); annual utilization ceiling of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable income exceeding EUR 1,000,000; limited 3-year carryback capped at EUR 1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 2065-SD (Déclaration de résultats) and standard annexes 2050-SD to 2059-SD; mandatory electronic filing through the Espace Fiscal des Entreprises (EFI/EDI) portal at impots.gouv.fr.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (per fiscal year ending 31 December for calendar-year SARL; non-calendar fiscal years accepted).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, the return is due on the second working day following 1 May (in practice 3 or 4 May); for any other fiscal year-end, the return is due within 3 months of the closing date; the final balance of IS is payable with the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre AA / AB (date d'ouverture / date de clôture)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dates of the beginning and end of the SARL's accounting period covered by the French corporate income tax return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the 12-month French statutory accounting period; non-resident shareholders do not file a separate French entity return for the SARL.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: SIREN registration number, legal form (SARL), registered office address, tax reference code, and legal representative details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SARL is the French tax resident; if the gérant is a non-resident, the name, personal address, and passport/identity details of the legal representative must still be accurately entered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal activity code and written description: APE code 5920Z (sound recording and music publishing) and description 'Location et cession de droits sur des œuvres musicales libre de droits'.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select the correct APE/NAF code matching ISIC 5920; no non-resident modification is permissible; incorrect activity coding may trigger audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre C1 / GH (bénéfice comptable avant IS)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting income before tax determined under French GAAP, after reintegration of non-deductible expenses and application of statutory depreciation, provisions, and fiscal adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the SARL's worldwide taxable profits subject to French CIT; profits attributable to a foreign permanent establishment may be sheltered by a tax treaty; non-resident ownership does not alter the entity-level filing basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre C1 / GL (résultat fiscal après imputation des déficits)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after deduction of previously carried-forward French tax losses; the prior-year losses claimed must be documented in the loss carryforward schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses of the French-resident SARL (and treaty-recognized French PE losses) are deductible; foreign shareholder-level losses and non-resident shareholder personal deductions cannot be entered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre D (calcul du montant de l'IS / taux réduit)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of corporate tax: EUR 42,500 at 15% reduced rate where eligible; the remaining taxable result at 25%; a 21.5% accrued supplementary contribution for large companies does not apply to a standard SME-position SARL.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The reduced-rate election is entity-level only and depends on French turnover and capital conditions; non-resident shareholder structure does not affect eligibility.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification of the return by the legal representative, cancellation of prior payments, and declaration of any tax agent appointment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident gérant must sign the electronic declaration personally via the EFI authentication process or grant an electronic power of attorney to a French tax representative/Chartered Accountant.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or failure to file Form 2065-SD: 10% surcharge on the tax due if filed within 30 days of a formal notice, 40% if filed later than 30 days after formal notice, 80% for fraudulent concealment (CGI Art. 1728); monthly late-payment interest of 0.2% of the outstanding tax (2.4% per annum) under CGI Art. 1727; additional flat penalties of EUR 150 per omitted or incomplete annex schedule.
